text: Escalating: Nordwind's Monday import failed again. 429 after roughly 1100 rows. This is ticket 3312, fourth of its kind.
Same root cause as the others. Fixed-window counter per API key, bulk import burns the whole minute budget in the first few seconds.
Understood. What I need is something to tell them that isn't 'split your file'.
Ticket 3318: Hafenlogistik asking why their API limit is 600/min when the docs say 1000/min. Anyone know if the docs are wrong or the limit is?
Docs are wrong. We dropped the default to 600 during the November incident and never updated them.
Filing a docs bug. That's the second customer to catch that.
